01

“grieved [asifan]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
grieved [asifan] [al-Araf 150] meaning: "distressed."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَسَفًا [الأعراف: 150] ، يَعْنِي: «جَزَعًا»
Edition record 372612 · p. 445Link to report ↗
02

“Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth an adornment for it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 18:7).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth an adornment for it [al-Kahf 7] meaning: "whatever is on it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَهَا [الكهف: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «مَا عَلَيْهَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ»
Edition record 372613 · p. 445Link to report ↗

04

“Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 18:9).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription [al-Kahf 9] he said: "The companions of the cave and the inscription, in their account, are among Our most wondrous signs. God says: they were not among Our most wondrous signs."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ [الكهف: 9] قَالَ: " كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْكَهْفِ، وَالرَّقِيمِ بَقَوْلِهِمْ أَعْجَبُ آيَاتِنَا، يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: وَلَمْ يَكُونُوا بِأَعْجَبَ آيَاتِنَا "
Edition record 372615 · p. 445Link to report ↗
05

“which of the two factions”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 18:12).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
which of the two factions [al-Kahf 12] He says: "of the people of the youths"; was better at calculating the time they had remained [al-Kahf 12] meaning: "the number."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَيُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ [الكهف: 12] يَقُولُ: «مِنْ قَوْمِ الْفِتْيَةِ» أَحْصَى لِمَا لَبِثُوا أَمَدًا [الكهف: 12] ، يَعْنِي: «عَدَدًا»
Edition record 372616 · p. 446Link to report ↗

34

“and they were not able to hear”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Abū Umāma al-Bāhilī (Q 18:101).

41
Explanation from Mujāhid 41

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
and they were not able to hear [al-Kahf 101] He says: "they do not understand and are unable to hear the good."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَكَانُوا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا [الكهف: 101] ، يَقُولُ: «لَا يَعْقِلُونَ وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ يَسْمَعُوا الْخَيْرَ»
Edition record 372652 · p. 451Link to report ↗
42
Report from Abū Umāma 42

Abū Umāma al-Bāhilī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Fudala related to us, from Luqman ibn Amir, from Abu Umama al-Bahili, who said:
"The Firdaws is the navel of Paradise."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا أَبُو فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ لُقْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ، قَالَ:
" الْفِرْدَوْسُ: هِيَ سُرَّةُ الْجَنَّةِ "

35

“they will not desire from it any transfer”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 18:108).

43
Explanation from Mujāhid 43

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid,
they will not desire from it any transfer [al-Kahf 108] he said: "meaning a change of place."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا [الكهف: 108] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مُتَحَوَّلًا»

“If the sea were ink”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 18:109).

44
Explanation from Mujāhid 44

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
If the sea were ink [al-Kahf 109], he said: "meaning for the pen."
